stories.title: The clandestine operation to secure Britain’s fridges.

The UK was largely unaffected by the recent wave of industrial fridge and freezer hacks across Europe, thanks to reliance on different manufacturers. Security researchers at Omega Solutions discovered a similar vulnerability though, prompting a secret, nationwide effort to secure tens of thousands of supermarket fridges before hackers caught up — in many cases by simply taking them offline.
